edges: Senate Republicans deny that the delay in scheduling a vote on Lynch's nomination is due to her being African-American.
Race is considered a major factor in the delay of Lynch's nomination by the new Republicans.
The Senate will have been in session longer than the combined time of the previous eight nominees.
The time between the Senate Judiciary Committee's vote and the full Senate vote has lasted longer for Lynch than for any recent attorney general nominee.
